contract: Desired-state success is eligible only when lifecycle phase is verified.
rolled_back is recovery and must never be reported as desired-state deployment success.
A final fresh independently acquired read-back is compared with desired managed state using the generic 13.6 verifier.
Management, connectivity, intended behavior and negative controls must all be explicitly true.
Zero drift plus all operational checks is required for PASS.
The validator exposes no transport, apply, rollback or production-writer capability.
